_comment_active_prompt: The active system prompt template to use for conversations
_comment_debug: Enable debug output for troubleshooting (shows topic detection details, etc.)
_comment_show_cost: Display token usage and cost information after each response
_comment_show_drift: Show semantic drift scores during topic detection
_comment_muse_mode: Muse mode: treat all input as web search queries (like Perplexity)
_comment_response_style: Global response style for all modes: concise, standard, comprehensive, custom
_comment_response_format: Global response format for all modes: paragraph, bulleted, mixed, academic
_comment_automatic_topic_detection: Enable automatic topic detection during conversations
_comment_auto_compress_topics: Automatically compress topics when they end (reduces context size)
_comment_resummarize_completed_topics: Re-extract topic name when topic ends (uses full context for better naming)
_comment_min_messages_before_topic_chang: Minimum user messages in current topic before checking for topic changes
_comment_show_topics: Display topic evolution information in responses
_comment_analyze_topic_boundaries: Analyze recent messages to find precise topic boundaries when topic changes
_comment_use_llm_boundary_analysis: Use LLM for boundary analysis instead of heuristics (more accurate but costs tokens)
_comment_topic_granularity: Topic detection granularity: fine (many boundaries), medium (balanced), coarse (major themes only)
_comment_use_drift_trigger: Use embedding drift as fast-path trigger for topic detection (catches sharp topic shifts earlier)
_comment_suspect_threshold: Neural confidence threshold to enter SUSPECT state (0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive)
_comment_drift_suspect_threshold: Drift threshold to trigger SUSPECT state (0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive)
_comment_neural_commit_drift_threshold: For neural-triggered SUSPECT, require drift >= this to COMMIT (prevents subtopic splits). Set null to disable.
_comment_topic_decision_logging: Log all topic decisions for drift calibration and evaluation
_comment_topic_decision_log_path: Path to write topic decision logs (relative to ~/.episodic/)
_comment_topic_context_retrieval: Enable automatic retrieval of context from previous topics when returning to them
_comment_topic_context_max_messages: Maximum messages to retrieve from previous topics
_comment_topic_context_max_tokens: Maximum tokens to retrieve from previous topics
_comment_enable_topic_reactivation: Enable implicit topic reactivation (detects when user message relates to dormant topic and injects context)
_comment_context_recovery_mode: Context assembly strategy: ancestry (traditional), topic_local (topic isolation), hybrid (switches based on reactivation)
_comment_context_token_budget: Maximum tokens to use for context assembly (default 4000)
_comment_summary_min_new_exchanges: Minimum new exchanges before a topic needs re-summarization
_comment_summary_model: Model for topic summarization (null = use compression_model)
_comment_anchor_count: Number of semantic anchors to retrieve for topic-local context
_comment_import_detection_enabled: Enable cross-topic import detection (when user references another topic)
_comment_import_token_budget: Maximum tokens for imported cross-topic context
_comment_reactivation_log_features: Log detailed probe features for every reactivation decision
_comment_show_reactivation_decisions: Show one-liner when topic reactivation fires (silent for CONTINUE, DISAMBIGUATE has its own prompt)
_comment_min_anchors_for_topic_local: Minimum anchors required before using topic_local (otherwise falls back to ancestry)
_comment_min_tokens_for_topic_local: Minimum tokens required before using topic_local (otherwise falls back to ancestry)
_comment_enable_relevance_truncation: Enable relevance-aware truncation (Phase 2): drops by importance score instead of age. REQUIRES anchor_indices at call site; raises ValueError if enabled without anchors.
_comment_context_target_T: Global token target for assembled context (hard cap, conservative value below model max)
_comment_context_overhead_estimate: Estimated tokens for fixed overhead (system prompt, topic header, user message)
_comment_summary_max_tokens: Maximum tokens for injected summary (s_max). Summary truncated at injection, stored unchanged.
_comment_anchor_alpha: Fraction of memory budget M allocated to anchors (A = alpha * M). Range 0.0-1.0.
_comment_anchor_retrieval_count: Number of anchor candidates to retrieve from Chroma before filtering
_comment_hybrid: // === LEGACY DETECTION FLAGS (DEPRECATED - use topic_strategy instead) ===
_comment_dual_window_high_precision_thre: Similarity threshold for (4,1) detection (lower = fewer boundaries, conservative default)
_comment_dual_window_safety_net_threshol: Similarity threshold for (4,2) safety net detection
_comment_hybrid_topic_weights: Weight distribution for hybrid detection signals (must sum to 1.0)
_comment_hybrid_topic_threshold: Overall threshold for hybrid topic change detection (0.0-1.0)
_comment_hybrid_llm_threshold: Threshold below which to use LLM fallback for confirmation
_comment_drift_threshold: Threshold for sliding window detection (0.9+ indicates topic change)
_comment_stream_responses: Enable streaming responses for better user experience
_comment_stream_rate: Words per second for constant-rate streaming
_comment_stream_constant_rate: Use constant rate streaming instead of token-based streaming
_comment_stream_natural_rhythm: Add natural pauses and rhythm to streaming (commas, periods, etc.)
_comment_stream_char_mode: Stream character by character instead of word by word
_comment_main_params: Parameters for main conversation with LLM

main_params._comment_gpt5_verbosity: GPT-5 verbosity: 'low' for concise, 'medium' (default), 'high' for detailed

_comment_topic_params: Parameters for topic detection (lower temp for consistency)
_comment_intent_params: Parameters for intent classification (low temp for consistency)
_comment_extraction_params: Parameters for KG extraction (deterministic JSON output)
_comment_use_context_cache: Use context caching to reduce API costs (when supported by provider)
_comment_compression_model: Model for topic compression (ollama/phi4 for local, null to use main model)
_comment_compression_min_nodes: Minimum nodes required before allowing compression
_comment_show_compression_notifications: Show notifications when topics are compressed
_comment_topic_detection_model: Model for topic boundary detection (custom/topic-boundary-distilbert for local neural model, or API model)
_comment_topic_naming_model: Model for topic naming (null = use compression_model, can be specialized model)
_comment_intent_model: Model for memory query intent classification (fast model preferred)
_comment_extraction_model: Model for KG extraction (Haiku 4.5 for speed/cost/quality balance)
_comment_color_mode: Color mode: none, basic, or full
_comment_text_wrap: Enable text wrapping for long lines
_comment_context_depth: Default context depth for building conversation history
_comment_enable_tab_completion: Enable tab completion for commands and parameters
_comment_interface_mode: Interface mode: simple (7 commands) or advanced (all commands)
_comment_use_llm_filenames: Use LLM to generate descriptive filenames when saving conversations
_comment_show_input_box: Display user input in a styled box after typing
_comment_use_unicode_boxes: Use Unicode box-drawing characters (disable for basic terminals)
_comment_export_directory: Directory for saving exported markdown files (~ is expanded to home directory)
_comment_memory_relevance_threshold: Minimum relevance score for memory search results (0.0-1.0)
_comment_conversation_retrieval_enabled: Enable retrieval of relevant past conversations for context
_comment_conversation_retrieval_k: Number of conversation memory results to retrieve
_comment_search_query_expansion: Automatically expand queries with related concepts
_comment_expansion_max_depth: Maximum hierarchy depth for concept expansion (1-3)
_comment_conceptual_boost_factor: How much to boost conceptually related results (0.0-1.0)
_comment_wordnet_expansion_mode: Expansion mode: narrow (parents only), balanced (both), broad (aggressive), children_only (children only)
_comment_rag_enabled: Enable RAG for your own indexed documents
_comment_rag_auto_search: Automatically search knowledge base for each user message
_comment_rag_search_threshold: Minimum relevance score for including search results (0.0-1.0)
_comment_rag_max_results: Maximum number of search results to include in context
_comment_rag_embedding_model: Sentence transformer model for creating embeddings
_comment_rag_context_prefix: Text added before RAG context in prompts
_comment_rag_chunk_size: Number of words per document chunk when indexing
_comment_rag_chunk_overlap: Number of overlapping words between chunks
_comment_rag_max_file_size: Maximum file size for indexing in bytes (10MB)
_comment_rag_show_citations: Show which documents were used in responses
_comment_web_search_enabled: Enable web search functionality for current information
_comment_web_search_providers: Ordered list of search providers (first is primary, others are fallbacks)
_comment_web_search_fallback_enabled: Enable automatic fallback to next provider
_comment_web_search_fallback_cache_minut: Cache working provider for N minutes
_comment_web_search_auto_enhance: Automatically search web when local RAG results are insufficient
_comment_web_search_cache_duration: Cache duration for search results in seconds (1 hour)
_comment_web_search_bypass_cache_for_tim: Bypass cache for time-sensitive queries (weekend/today/latest) to keep Muse fresh
_comment_web_search_max_results: Maximum number of web results to retrieve
_comment_web_search_rate_limit: Maximum searches allowed per hour (rate limiting)
_comment_web_search_index_results: Index web search results into RAG for future use (security: default off for web content)
_comment_web_search_require_confirmation: Ask for confirmation before performing web searches
_comment_web_search_excluded_domains: List of domains to exclude from search results
_comment_web_search_time_sensitive_exclu: Domains to exclude for time-sensitive event queries
_comment_web_search_show_urls: Show URLs in search result display
_comment_web_search_extract_content: Extract actual page content from search results (slower)
_comment_muse_extract_min_chars: Minimum extracted text length to accept for Muse grounding
_comment_web_extract_max_pages: Maximum number of pages to extract content from (fetched in parallel)
_comment_web_extract_timeout: Global timeout in seconds for parallel page extraction
_comment_web_search_synthesize: Synthesize search results into comprehensive answer
_comment_web_show_raw: Show raw search results instead of synthesizing
_comment_muse_detail: Detail level: minimal, moderate, detailed, maximum
_comment_muse_max_tokens: Direct token limit (overrides style if set)
_comment_muse_model: Model for synthesis (deprecated - use synthesis_model instead)
_comment_synthesis_model: Model for web search synthesis (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 recommended, null to use main model)
_comment_critic_model: Model for /critique command (sophisticated model recommended for substantive critiques)
_comment_muse_context_depth: Number of previous messages to include as context in muse mode
_comment_muse_sanitize_html: Sanitize HTML from web pages (L0 security)
_comment_muse_isolate_content: Wrap web content in untrusted_content tags (L1 security)
_comment_web_auto_index_rag: Auto-index web synthesis results into RAG (security: default off)
_comment_muse_flush_on_mode_switch: Flush web-derived context when switching out of muse mode
_comment_muse_kg_quarantine: Quarantine KG triples extracted from muse responses
_comment_muse_escalation_gate: Enhanced confirmation for tool calls when web-derived context present
_comment_muse_rag_in_tool_context: Include untrusted RAG chunks in tool-enabled context
_comment_muse_max_chars_per_source: Max chars per web source in synthesis prompt
_comment_muse_max_chars_total: Max total chars from web sources in synthesis prompt
_comment_searx_instance_url: Searx instance URL (can be self-hosted for privacy)
_comment_google_search_engine_id: Google Custom Search Engine ID (or set GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID env var)
_comment_bing_api_key: Bing Search API key (or set BING_API_KEY env var)
_comment_drift_embedding_model: Model name for drift detection embeddings
_comment_file_ref_vision_pages: Default number of pages to render when using @file.pdf:vision (without page range)
_comment_file_ref_max_text_size: Maximum text content size in characters (content is truncated beyond this)
_comment_pdf_extractor: PDF text extraction library: pdfplumber (default) or marker (better for tables/academic)
_comment_voice_mode: Enable voice mode for speech input/output (use /voice command)
_comment_voice_tts_provider: Text-to-speech provider: local_piper, local_xtts, openai_tts, elevenlabs, azure_neural
_comment_voice_tts_enabled: Enable TTS output (disable to use speech input only)
_comment_voice_local_whisper_model: Local Whisper model: tiny (fast), base (balanced), small, medium, large-v2, large-v3 (best)
_comment_voice_openai_tts_voice: OpenAI TTS voice: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer
_comment_voice_azure_neural_voice: Azure Neural voice. DragonHD voices (highest quality) require eastus/westeurope/swedencentral/southeastasia region
_comment_voice_silence_threshold_ms: Milliseconds of silence to end speech (lower = faster, may cut off)
_comment_voice_vad_aggressiveness: Voice Activity Detection sensitivity 0-3 (higher = filters more noise)
_comment_voice_audio_cues: Play audio cues for state transitions
_comment_voice_idle_timeout: Seconds of inactivity before entering wake word mode (0 = never idle)
_comment_voice_wake_word: Wake word to reactivate voice mode from idle (porcupine built-in: alexa, americano, blueberry, bumblebee, computer, grapefruit, grasshopper, hey google, hey siri, jarvis, ok google, picovoice, porcupine, terminator)
_comment_voice_wake_word_sensitivity: Wake word detection sensitivity 0.0-1.0 (higher = more sensitive, may cause false positives)
_comment_voice_wake_word_enabled: Enable automatic idle mode with wake word activation
_comment_voice_wake_word_interrupts_spee: Allow wake word to interrupt TTS playback (requires AEC/full-duplex mic to avoid self-triggering)
_comment_porcupine_access_key: Picovoice access key for wake word detection (free at https://console.picovoice.ai/)
_comment_azure_speech_key: Azure Speech key for TTS (or set AZURE_SPEECH_KEY env var)
_comment_mcp_host: Host to bind the MCP server to (default: 127.0.0.1)
_comment_mcp_servers: External MCP servers to connect to as a client (server_id -> {command, args, env, lifecycle})
_comment_kg_interval: KG extraction interval in seconds (default: 1 hour)
_comment_kg_lookback: Number of preceding turns for extraction context
_comment_kg_budget: Token budget for KG context in context assembly
_comment_kg_context: Enable KG facts in context assembly (Phase 1)
_comment_kg_max_entities: Maximum entities to match per user message
_comment_kg_max_edges: Maximum edges to retrieve per matched entity
_comment_kg_include_past: Include TIME_PAST tagged edges by default (otherwise only with past-tense cues)
_comment_kg_realtime: Enable per-turn background KG extraction (daemon thread per user message)
_comment_kg_closure_seed_limit: Max matched entities used as closure seeds
_comment_kg_derived_per_seed: Max derived edges per seed entity
_comment_kg_relevance_gate: Suppress block if no direct overlap and no seeded closure
_comment_mode_setting: Current mode: local (free, private) or cloud (paid, quality)
_comment_local_model: Default chat model for local mode
_comment_cloud_model: Default chat model for cloud mode
